consts.name: dlwYearsOfState
consts.comment: the years of the state - Shou Lung in existence over 1,200 years in one form or another, the oldest state of Kara-Tur (print capture p. 303)

consts.name: dlwDynastyCount
consts.comment: the dynasty count - the Kuo Dynasty of emperor Chin the eighth dynasty to rule the land (print capture p. 303)

consts.name: dlwProvinceCount
consts.comment: the province count - Shou Lung divided into 14 provinces, each headed by a governor (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwReceiverOfTheDragon
bools.comment: the receiver of the dragon - the empire name Shou Lung meaning Receiver of the Dragon (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwLargestMostPowerful
bools.comment: the largest and most powerful empire of Kara-Tur (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwOldestState
bools.comment: the oldest state of Kara-Tur (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwEmperorAllHistory
bools.comment: the emperor all history - ruled by an emperor for all of its history (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwTurmoilPeriods
bools.comment: the turmoil periods - the few periods of turmoil the exception to the imperial rule (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwKuoDynastyChin
bools.comment: the Kuo dynasty Chin - the head and center of the state the current emperor Chin of the Kuo Dynasty (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwExaminedBureaucracy
bools.comment: the examined bureaucracy - manned by thousands of officials major and minor chosen by a system of examinations given throughout the land (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwCommonerRise
bools.comment: the commoner rise - even the poorest commoner can rise to an influential position provided he is talented enough and studies hard (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwGovernorPerProvince
bools.comment: the governor per province - each of the 14 provinces headed by a governor (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwDistrictOwnOfficial
bools.comment: the district own official - the provinces divided into districts each with its own official (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwOfficialDuties
bools.comment: the official duties - at each level the officials responsible for the management of those beneath them, the hearing of court cases, keeping the peace, the collection of taxes, and the construction of public works (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwRoadsAndBridges
bools.comment: the roads and bridges - the well-maintained network connecting the provinces, creating a regular flow of trade between them (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwImperialMessengers
bools.comment: the imperial messengers - the extensive network stationed at depots throughout the land to carry news to and from the capital city Tien Shih (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwDikesAndDams
bools.comment: the dikes and dams - extensive areas built along the major rivers to reduce the risk of flooding (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlwCoinageAndPaper
bools.comment: the coinage and paper - regular coinage and paper money minted and honored throughout the land (print capture p. 303)
